description: One call on a named Texas substation (or the nearest one to a point): high and low side voltage and OpenStreetMap station class, owner, city and county, lines connected, an inferred station class (distribution, transmission, switching, generation tie, customer-owned) with its evidence, how likely_utility was derived and whether it disagrees with the station owner, transmission within 2 miles, battery storage projects whose point of interconnection is this substation (with stage and MW), generation queue nearby, 7-day wholesale prices at the nearest pricing nodes and load zone, planned upgrades within 10 miles, and who owns the land around it. Use for 'tell me about the Lolita substation', 'what is the low side voltage at Normanna', 'what is interconnecting at Hillje', or 'who owns the land next to this sub'. Names are also matched against OpenStreetMap names. Planned upgrades, mapped transformers and OpenStreetMap-only stations nearby are Pro; free accounts see how many there are.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

county.description: County, to pick between substations with the same name.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

name.description: Substation name or ERCOT substation code, e.g. 'Lolita', 'Hillje'. Spelling can be approximate.

name: substation_detail
title: Everything about one substation
